name: LinkedIn Company Employees API | No Login, No Cookies
description: LinkedIn Company Employees API: give a company name or LinkedIn URL and get the people who work there, with name, title, location and profile URL. Each person is checked against their public profile. No login, no cookies. Filter by job title and location.
